transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

I'm... well, I'm here because of work. The environmental modeling contract. I'm pretty sure the people on that team are... tracking my revisions. Planting errors in the datasets. They want to make it look like I can't lead the work. My wife and the junior analysts say it's just version-control mistakes, but... I know what I'm seeing.
Have you ever heard voices or sounds that other people couldn't hear?
No, I... I haven't. Just the dataset issues.
How long have you felt that your coworkers were planting errors in your work?
I'd say... about two months. That's when I knew for certain they were tracking my revisions and... planting the errors.
Over the past couple of months, have you been feeling persistently down, depressed, or hopeless?
No... I wouldn't say that. I'm not depressed. Just... trying to sort out the contract.
